top_choice_rationale: P002 credits a clean prediction-then-discovery sequence: the Bistritzer-MacDonald continuum model located flat bands at a magic twist angle, and the 2018 experiments at that angle found correlated insulating and superconducting states, since reproduced in many laboratories and extended to other moire platforms. The open pairing mechanism is a follow-up question, not the discovery. Weaknesses are real (young field, twist-angle disorder, Cao and Fatemi outside the three-name limit) and I rank P001, a mature and cleanly attributed two-name award, second. Any award is preferred to no award.
